title: alchemilla carniolica
intro: Alchemilla carniolica, commonly known as the Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and is often used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Alchemilla carniolica include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce swelling, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm and relax the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of various digestive issues, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins.
